Introducing the Falak Tayyeb Rewards Program – your gateway to enjoying more from your everyday spending. Every time you use your Falak Tayyeb Credit Card for shopping, dining, travel, entertainment, and other eligible purchases, you earn Falak Tayyeb Reward Points, redeemable for a range of exciting rewards, including cashback.

Your rewards are now easier than ever to access. Simply log in to the Falak Tayyeb Rewards Portal to view your points balance, track eligible transactions in real time, browse the rewards catalogue, and redeem your points seamlessly.
Rewards Portal:
https://rewards.mawarid.ae/
Earn Reward Points worth up to 10% of your spend on Grocery, Dining, and Fuel with your Falak Tayyeb Credit Card (World Elite, World, Platinum, or Titanium).
For all other eligible local and international retail transactions, earn Reward Points worth 2% of your spend.
Statement Period and Reward Points Posting
Reward Points are earned per statement period. Each statement period runs from the 16th of one month to the 15th of the following month.
The category and total Reward Points caps are applied per statement period and reset at the beginning of each new statement period.
Reward Points for eligible transactions will be credited to your rewards account on a specified date following the end of the statement period.
Example Posting Date: Reward Points earned on transactions posted between 16th May and 15th June 2025 will be credited on 16th July 2025.

Transactions under the following MCCs are not eligible for rewards
Monthly Profit, Fees, Balance Transfer transactions, Easy Payment Plan converted transactions and Cash Withdrawals are not eligible to earn Reward Points.
Government payments, utilities, charity, rental and telecom spends, and quasi-cash transactions (including Easy Cash, Balance Transfer and Cash on Call) do not earn Reward Points.
Reward Points earned on Supplementary and Internet Cards will be credited to the Primary Cardholder’s rewards account.

Reward Points can be redeemed through the Rewards Portal for cashback, travel, vouchers and other rewards. Where Reward Points are redeemed as cashback, the equivalent amount will be credited in AED to the Credit Card account.

Reward Points Terms & Conditions Disclosure

Reward Points benefits offered under Mawarid Finance credit cards are calculated solely based on the Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) assigned to each transaction. These MCCs are provided by the acquiring bank, payment network, or merchant at the point of sale.

Reward Points eligibility, applicable earning rates, and exclusions are strictly determined based on the MCC received with the transaction at the time of processing. Mawarid Finance reserves the absolute and sole discretion to determine Reward Points qualification in accordance with the transaction data received through its payment systems.
Reward Points calculations are not based on the customer’s perception of the nature of the purchase, but exclusively on the MCC assigned to the transaction.

Mawarid Finance has no obligation to reassess, adjust, or compensate Reward Points where a transaction is categorized under an MCC that differs from the actual nature of the merchant’s business or goods/services provided.

Mawarid Finance reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to amend Reward Points categories, earning rates, eligible MCCs, and exclusions at any time without prior notice, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.

A loyalty program by Mawarid Finance that lets you earn reward points on eligible credit card purchases, redeemable for travel, shopping, vouchers, and more via the Rewards portal.
